Task: wire the live results mapper into the API runtime. Touch ONLY src/app/api/live/_lib/runtime.ts and tests/live/handlers.test.ts. Same rules as before: never read .env or print environment variables or keys; no network or database calls in tests. Read first: src/app/api/live/_lib/runtime.ts, src/app/live/_lib/live-results.ts (toLiveResultsDto and its context type) and tests/live/handlers.test.ts.
1. In runtime.ts, use toLiveResultsDto from the live page's _lib as deps.toResults for BOTH modes (synthetic and live); remove the use of toResultsDto there. Set LIVE_RESULTS_MAPPER to toLiveResultsDto (it is now live-safe: it reports estimated provider cost, model cost with its basis, and never claims zero spend for live runs). Update the comment above LIVE_RESULTS_MAPPER accordingly. Keep every other fail-safe as it is: live deps stay null unless DATABASE_URL, INVITE_HMAC_SECRET and all three live variables are present (CRUSTDATA_LIVE_API_KEY, LIVE_LLM_API_KEY, LIVE_LLM_BASE_URL); keep the buildLiveDeps mapper parameter so the fail-closed behaviour with a null mapper stays testable.
2. Tests: with a non-null mapper and all keys present (fakes only), a live code uses the injected live factories and gets results whose run.mode is live; with a null mapper and keys present, live deps are still null and a live code gets 503 live_disabled; a synthetic code through the real runLive path with the real toLiveResultsDto gives a 200 body whose keys are exactly status, mode, results, usage, notices, whose usage is exactly { runsRemaining }, and whose results.run has mode synthetic, data_source fixtures, model_basis none and model_complete true, and contains no actual_spend_usd field; add a JSON scan asserting that no response body from a synthetic run contains the string crustdata.
Run npx vitest run, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint and npm run build. End with a plain-text SHORT REVIEW REPORT (under 25 lines, no code fences, no secrets): what changed, the new test names, the four results as one line each, and anything you were unsure about.
</pasted_content id="47de">

SHORT REVIEW REPORT

What changed
- `src/app/api/live/_lib/runtime.ts`: `toLiveResultsDto` replaces `toResultsDto`. `LIVE_RESULTS_MAPPER` is now `toLiveResultsDto`, and its comment is updated.
- Synthetic runs call `toLiveResultsDto` directly. Live runs go through the `mapper` parameter, and with a null mapper that path still throws.
- The fail-safes are unchanged. Live deps stay null unless all five variables are present and the mapper is non-null.
- `tests/live/handlers.test.ts`: the old "mapper is null" test is replaced by three tests. Only these two files were touched.

New tests (in the "runtime fail-safe" block)
- runs a live code through the injected live factories when a mapper is present
- keeps live deps null and answers live_disabled when the mapper is null
- returns the exact live-safe synthetic body shape through the real runLive path

Results
- `npx vitest run`: 741 passed, 6 skipped (the 6 skips are in the 1 skipped file; I didn't check which).
- `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean.
- `npm run lint`: clean.
- `npm run build`: succeeded.

Unsure about
- Your asked-for JSON scan for "crustdata" is not a separate test. It sits inside the synthetic-shape test and covers that one synthetic response. It is case-insensitive, and it also checks that `actual_spend_usd` is absent.
- The live-mapper test checks `run.mode` is live and that both factories were called once. It does not assert the live cost fields.
- The test fakes (`FixtureProvider`, `FakeLlmClient`) are inlined in `handlers.test.ts` rather than shared with `run-live.test.ts`, because I was limited to two files.

I didn't read `.env`, print any environment values, or make any network or database calls.
